title: Declaration of Independence: From Drafting to Signing
learningObjectives: Sequence the key steps from the appointment of the drafting committee to the engrossing and signing of the Declaration.
Identify the dates of adoption, printing, and ordering of the engrossed copy.
Order the revision, adoption, and signing events in chronological order.

explanations.text: The Declaration was adopted in early July after a revision process, then printed for distribution before an engrossed copy was ordered and signed.

evidence.quote: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.
It was engrossed on parchment and on August 2, 1776, delegates began signing it.
